notes: Honda MyGarage (Salesforce Experience Cloud) is a dynamic SPA: a guest picks Year/Model/Trim on /s/find-honda (no login, no VIN), then /s/owners-manuals lists PDFs. Links were collected from the portal's own guest Apex endpoints (POST https://mygarage.honda.com/s/sfsites/aura): FindProductController.getProductChooserData {division:'Honda'} -> modelId per year/model/trim; OwnManualsApiController.getManualByModelIdAuto {divisionId:'A', division:'Honda', modelId} -> manualsList[{title,url,year}]; OwnAPIController.getEmissionWarrantyBooklet {modelId} -> warranty booklet path, prefixed with https://owners.honda.com/ exactly as the page JS does. One trim per year/model was queried plus the first hybrid trim. Owner's manual PDFs are hosted on techinfo.honda.com (free, no login; the portal returns http:// URLs, served as application/pdf). Each PDF verified with GET Range bytes=0-1023 (206, %PDF). Interactive (HTML) manuals for 2022+ also verified (206 text/html). Navigation and CarPlay/Android Auto manuals are also listed by the portal but omitted here. All documents are US (American Honda; site footer: 'Applies To U.S. Products Only'). Quirks preserved as listed by the portal: 2014 'Accord Coupe Owner's Manual' points to .../A2A1414OM/enu/2A1414OM.PDF while '2014 Accord Sedan Owner's Manual' points to .../A2A14SEOM/... ; 2020 CR-V Hybrid URL mixes codes (ATMA2020OM/enu/ATPG2020OMEN.PDF) but verifies as a PDF. Civic Si (2014-2026) and Civic Type R (2017-2026) have no separate owner's manual: the portal returns the Civic Coupe/Sedan (Si) and Civic Hatchback (Type R) manuals for them. Civic Hybrid exists 2014-2015 and 2025-2026; Accord Hybrid 2014-2015, 2017-2026 (no 2016 model); Accord Plug-In 2014; CR-V Hybrid 2020-2026. CR-V e:FCEV (2025-2026) excluded. Out-of-range extra seen: 2027 CR-V and CR-V Hybrid owner's manuals (A3A02727OM/A3D42727OM) are already published.
